protocol.weighting: Equal weights for Generalization variants, tasks within categories, and the five categories at their respective levels.
protocol.uncertainty: 95% paired task-bootstrap intervals, 10000 draws stratified by category, conditional on frozen harnesses.

inputs.label: Task description
inputs.note: Pure task description. The same Astra/xhigh executor and 210 Test scenes are used in both conditions.

inputs.label: Task description + wiki
inputs.note: Wiki recipes are available in both Playground and Test. Experience is acquired independently for this input setting, selected after earlier outcomes were inspected.

fullEvaluation.note: 50 scenes per task, one seed, with task-specific Playground exploration including Open tasks. The wiki setting was selected after earlier results; development and Full Evaluation scene pools can overlap. External leaderboard protocols are not standardized against this evaluation.

crossTask.note: Fixed target means, separate from the 42-task average. All producers and executors are Astra/xhigh. Related and mismatched sources use no target-task Playground.

acquisition.note: Token-based estimates under the recorded rate schedule, not provider invoices. Missing historical usage leaves campaign totals incomplete. Shared acquisition is counted once across consumers.
